_comment: Paste the bot token into ALERT.gs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_INLINE or Script Properties. NEVER commit a real token to git.
token_location: Apps Script → Project Settings → Script Properties → TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
onboarding_instructions: Each supervisor messages the bot with their full name. Bot auto-matches and registers their chat_id. Owner messages 'Yash Munot' or 'owner'.
